security.finding: write-side RLS left unscoped on five crm7 tables

unattributable.why: No .insert/.update/.delete against award_rates exists anywhere reachable from a UI surface. src/services/importExportService.ts's importToSupabase() CAN insert/upsert into award_rates (ENTITY_TABLE_MAP.awards = 'award_rates'), but it has zero callers anywhere in the app (only its own module/tests and the services barrel) — no import wizard page wires entityType:'awards' to it. src/pages/payroll/award-rates/{index,create}.tsx (the index row most plausibly 'owning' this table by name) write to a DIFFERENT table, rate_schedules, not award_rates. This matches the migration's own admission that award_rates has 'zero live rows' and (per src/services/requoteOnRiseService.ts's comment) 'no writer anywhere in BSuite'.

Zero occurrences of 'charge_calculations' in any crm7 .ts/.tsx file (searched language:TypeScript and language:TSX — 0 hits each; only docs/*.md and supabase/migrations/*.sql reference it). docs/plans/20260423-bsuite-gto-master-plan-v1.00W.md's ownership table names R8 as sole owner ('R8 (via charge_calculations / host_charge_rates)') with CRM7 listed only as an aspirational future reader ('CRM7 (invoicing)') that was never built. This table is not owned, read, or written by any crm7 feature at all — the RLS exposure sits on a table crm7's own app code never touches; risk should attach to R8, not to any crm7 index row.

Zero .from('host_contracts') calls anywhere in crm7 TS/TSX (searched both quote styles). The only two hits are (1) a code COMMENT in crm7/src/pages/contracts/index.tsx explaining that host_contracts was deliberately REMOVED from that page's aggregation at crm7#1577 ('doesn't belong on a contracts page... still live, still readable... whether it is retired or wired to whatever was meant to read it is still an open question') and (2) a matching comment in crm7/src/pages/contracts/index.test.tsx. The migration's own comment ('host_contracts is referenced by a live page, crm7/src/pages/contracts/index.tsx') is stale/incorrect against the current code — that page fetches only training_contracts and host_agreements now. host_contracts is an orphaned pricing table with no live reader or writer anywhere in crm7.

correction_20260826.what_was_wrong: award_rates, host_contracts and whs_records were classified 'no writer anywhere' on the strength of finding no .insert/.update/.delete against them in source.
correction_20260826.what_is_true: All three are is_active, tenant_scope=tenant_column entries in public.report_catalog_entities, which is the allowlist the generic bulk import/update engine at /settings/data writes through. Any tenant owner/admin can pick them from a dropdown and write rows.
correction_20260826.why_the_method_failed: bulk_data_import/bulk_data_update resolve the target table from a DATABASE ROW and issue dynamic EXECUTE format(...). The table name is never in TypeScript. Invisible to source grep and to dry-lint's AST-based cross-app-write rule.
correction_20260826.second_order: Cuts the other way on severity: the bulk_data_* functions are SECURITY DEFINER and never evaluate RLS, so the unscoped write policy is not in that path. Its tenant gate is _bulk_data_write_authority with server-side tenant_id stamping (pgTAP 46). The unscoped policy matters for DIRECT client writes only.
correction_20260826.charge_calculations_and_financial_viabil: absent from report_catalog_entities — those two remain without a bulk-engine writer
correction_20260826.method_rule: For 'does anything write table X', ask the database first: report_catalog_entities allowlist; pg_proc.prosrc for dynamic SQL; view defs + security_invoker; pg_trigger; pg_constraint FKs; pg_policies on OTHER tables naming X. Only then read source.

journey_gaps.source: pass 5 round 5 — journey walk, not artifact enumeration
journey_gaps.note: These are product gaps: steps a user must perform with no surface at all. They are NOT index rows — there is no artifact to index. They belong in the backlog.

journey_gaps.gap: Invoicing hard-blocks on any overtime hour. billingEngine.ts's fetchTimesheetGroups() explicitly refuses to price overtime (throws 'Cannot generate invoice: overtime hours cannot be priced for ...') because it has no OT-tier breakdown to work from -- charge_rate_snapshots.calc_result.rates has the correct ot15/ot20/ot25/ph/night rates already computed, but nothing wires them into billing, and the intended fix path (populate `timesheet_groups`, the work-type -> pay-item-group lookup) has ZERO rows in practice per the code's own 2026-08-05 comment. The only workarounds are both manual and outside the system: record the hours as ordinary (silently under-bills the host) or price the overtime by hand.
journey_gaps.manual_work_imposed: Every host invoice touching an apprentice who logged overtime cannot be generated through the product at all until an operator either mis-codes the hours or computes and enters the OT amount manually outside crm7.
journey_gaps.evidence: src/lib/billingEngine.ts (crm7, sha 62fd36e7941a55eb44163e2f10a4e6e22c255f88), fetchTimesheetGroups() and its inline 2026-08-05 comment block.

journey_gaps.gap: No conversion action exists from a closed_won Opportunity (or its linked Client) to a Host Employer. src/pages/hosts/create.tsx only offers a ContactSelector (pre-fills contact name/email/phone); company name, industry, and address -- already captured on the Opportunity/Client -- must be retyped from scratch. Grepping the crm7 tree for any 'convert' file returns nothing.
journey_gaps.manual_work_imposed: Every won deal requires the operator to manually re-key the company's core details a second time into a separate form, with no cross-check against what's already on file.
journey_gaps.evidence: src/pages/hosts/create.tsx (crm7); src/lib/opportunities.ts (no host/employer conversion function); grep for 'convert' across crm7 tree returns zero files.

journey_gaps.gap: Conduit (the ATS) has no bulk/CSV import, bulk edit, or export surface anywhere -- confirmed by a full-tree grep for bulk/import/export/csv returning zero files, versus crm7 which has a dedicated bulk-data engine (src/services/bulkDataService.ts, /settings/data).
journey_gaps.manual_work_imposed: A GTO onboarding a batch of candidates (career fair, mass intake) must create every candidate one at a time via /candidates/new; no CSV path exists.
journey_gaps.evidence: grep -iE 'bulk|import|export|csv' across conduit.txt (540 files) -- zero matches.

journey_gaps.gap: crm7's host-employer vacancies (src/schemas/vacancy.ts, /hosts/vacancies) and conduit's candidate-facing job postings (src/stores/jobStore.ts, /jobs) are two entirely disconnected systems. crm7's vacancy schema has an `application_count` field that implies applications should flow into it, but nothing populates it; conduit's job schema has no `vacancy_id` or `host_employer_id` field.
journey_gaps.manual_work_imposed: A recruiter must manually track which crm7 vacancy corresponds to which conduit job ad and manually keep vacancy status/application counts in sync -- there is no data path between the two.
journey_gaps.evidence: src/schemas/vacancy.ts (crm7): application_count field with no writer found. GitHub code search org-wide for 'vacancy_id' OR 'host_employer_id' in conduit's jobStore.ts: zero hits.

No settings page edits any of these -- grep for rot-threshold/scanner-config/compliance-thresholds/alert-thresholds across the crm7 tree returns nothing.

bulk_gaps.detail: Zero bulk-import, bulk-edit, or export surfaces anywhere in the conduit repo. Every other repo with a comparable high-volume entity (crm7 people/apprentices) has a dedicated bulk-data engine; conduit has none.

seam_gaps.seam: crm7 host-employer vacancies <-> conduit candidate-facing job postings
seam_gaps.detail: No shared key, no sync job, no cross-link field either direction. See journey_gaps #4 for full evidence.

journeys_walked.journey: a. New host employer: first enquiry -> signed agreement -> first placement
steps: 1. Lead captured (web form / manual) -> crm7 /leads, public/embed/lead-form.html, supabase/functions/lead-capture -- SURFACE
2. Lead qualified -> Opportunity created, linked via opportunities.client_id -> crm7 /opportunities -- SURFACE
3. Opportunity reaches closed_won -- SURFACE (stage enum), but NO automated or single-click path to create the Host Employer record from the won opportunity/client -- NO SURFACE (see journey_gaps #1)
4. Host employer created -> crm7 /hosts/create (ContactSelector auto-fills contact fields only; company/industry/address re-keyed by hand) -- SURFACE (partial -- see gap)
5. Host site(s) added -> crm7 HostSitesPanel.tsx, /hosts sites -- SURFACE
6. WHS / capacity assessment -> /hosts/capacity-assessment, host-employer-whs-manager.tsx -- SURFACE
7. Host agreement generated & sent for signature -> /hosts/agreements/new, SendHostAgreementForSignatureDialog, supabase/functions/host-agreement-dispatch -- SURFACE
8. Agreement signed (token-based) -> /hosts/agreements/sign/[token] -- SURFACE
9. Vacancy posted against the host -> /hosts/vacancies/new -- SURFACE, but this record is NOT linked to any conduit job posting -- NO SURFACE for the seam (see seam_gaps #1)
10. Apprentice placed at the host -> /placements/create, placement workflow -- SURFACE

11. Timesheets approved -> host billed -> billingEngine.generateInvoiceFromTimesheets -- SURFACE, but BLOCKS with a thrown error the moment any overtime hour appears, because timesheet_groups (work-type -> pay-item-group lookup) ships with zero rows and nothing forces it to be populated before go-live -- NO SURFACE for the missing prerequisite step (see journey_gaps #2, the highest-manual-effort gap found this round)
journeys_walked.verdict: Fully surfaced end-to-end except two real gaps: no lead/opportunity->host conversion, and invoicing silently requires unenforced upstream config.

steps: 1. Front-door intake -> crm7 /people/new, /people/new/worker -- SURFACE
2. Placement created & tracked -> /placements, ApprenticePlacementForm -- SURFACE
3. Training plan / progress tracked -> /people/progress, training_plans -- SURFACE

4. Compliance scanning (doc expiry, site visits, training delay, agreement expiry, visa expiry) -> src/lib/compliance/alertScanner.ts, cron-driven -- SURFACE, but every threshold (30/28/90/60/90 days, 75% progress) is a hardcoded constant with no admin editor (see config_without_editor #1)
5. Change-of-year processing -> /admin/change-of-year -- SURFACE
6. Completion/withdrawal/cancellation tracked -> /people/completion (already indexed under crm7.people.compliance-progress code_anchors -- verified, not a miss) -- SURFACE
7. Handover to employment -> supabase/functions/handover-to-employment, scripts/e2e-rehearsal/handover-to-employment.mjs -- SURFACE
journeys_walked.verdict: Fully surfaced end-to-end. No gaps found on this journey this round.

journeys_walked.journey: c. Charge rate: award selection -> quote -> invoice
steps: 1. Award/occupation selection & rate calculation -> R80.4 calculator (public, no login required) -- SURFACE
2. Quote saved, templated, thread-grouped, compared -> r80.quote.* rows (save-local, server-sync, templates, compare-two-quotes) -- SURFACE
3. Quote handed off to crm7 via single-use token -> r80.quote.handoff-crm7, crm7.quote.r8-return-ticket round trip -- SURFACE
4. Charge rate applied to a placement -> ChargeRateCard, rateState.ts, rateProvenance.ts -- SURFACE
5. Timesheet -> invoice generation -> billingEngine.ts -- SURFACE, same overtime-pricing dead end as journey (a) step 11
journeys_walked.verdict: Fully surfaced; the one real defect (overtime pricing block) is shared with journey (a), not journey-specific.

journeys_walked.journey: d. Candidate: job ad -> application -> onboarded worker
steps: 1. Job ad posted publicly -> conduit /portal/careers, jobPostingJsonLd.ts (SEO) -- SURFACE, but conduit's job postings carry NO field linking back to a crm7 vacancy/host_employer_id -- NO SURFACE for the seam (same gap as journey a step 9, seam_gaps #1)
2. Application submitted -> /portal/careers/[jobId]/apply -- SURFACE
3. Screening / interview -> /interviews, InterviewScorecardDialog -- SURFACE
4. Offer generated & e-signed -> /offers, OfferSignModal, offerStateMachine.ts -- SURFACE
5. Onboarding -> /onboarding -- SURFACE

6. Convert to apprentice (cross-app handoff to crm7) -> _convert-to-apprentice-button.tsx mints a token, crm7 /apprentices/from-candidate consumes it -- SURFACE (confirmed both sides wired; already indexed both ends)
7. Once in crm7, re-enters journey (a)/(b) at placement creation -- SURFACE

8. Bulk intake of candidates (career fair, GTO batch onboarding of e.g. 200 apprentices) -- NO SURFACE anywhere in conduit: zero bulk/CSV/import/export files found in the entire conduit tree (see bulk_gaps #1)
journeys_walked.verdict: Well surfaced for the one-at-a-time path; no bulk path exists at all.

funding_ruling.ruling: R80.4's funding calculation is the only acceptable method of calculation. The placement-time look at funding refines a broad category estimate into an individual-specific amount — it replaces, it does not add a second set of funding. Funding is claimed from the funding body and tracked in its own ledger; it does not reduce what the host is charged.
funding_ruling.consequence_for_index: claim.B.0035 reclassified from 'funding double-count defect' to 'funding-model mismatch in unwired R80.4 module'; severity high->medium; money_impact under-quote->none-in-production

themes.one_line_ask: Give every card its own backing element so cards can be dragged and resized independently everywhere, as a platform-wide fix, not a page-by-page patch.

themes.theme: Reports, funding-source, training-provider, and every other row-listing screen still don't look or behave like the planned Airtable-style spreadsheet view

themes.theme: Platform-level admin surfaces (permissions, branding, platform kit, custom reporting) leak into tenant/enterprise accounts, and permission checkboxes never reflect or persist what's actually granted
themes.one_line_ask: Gate every platform-level admin surface to developer accounts only, and make permission checkboxes load pre-checked to actual state and persist edits.

themes.theme: The D2C dark/gradient theme isn't applied consistently — pure white/black surfaces, missing gradients, and missing glows recur across every app

themes.theme: Card borders render wrong (doubled, blurry, or cut off) because the visual edge is a box-shadow ring rather than a real CSS border
themes.one_line_ask: Replace the box-shadow-as-border hack with a real border so card edges stop rendering doubled or blurry, across the app.

themes.theme: There is no working export-to-PDF / save-template / push-to-record / send-for-eSigning flow for quotes, contracts, or documents
themes.one_line_ask: Build one working export/save-template/push-to-record/eSign flow and reuse it everywhere a quote or contract needs to leave the app.

themes.theme: There is still no way for a client to connect and use their own email account inside CRM7
themes.one_line_ask: Ship a working, correctly-scoped OAuth flow so clients can connect and send from their own SMTP/Google/Azure mailbox, and close the auth popup properly.

themes.theme: The same piece of data has to be entered or selected more than once instead of propagating (one-shot policy violations)
themes.one_line_ask: Enforce the one-shot data policy end to end: entering or selecting something once should carry through to every place that needs it.
